title: ipfs mcp agent settings: write shape
description: Body of PUT on the settings route (ADR-0009 sections 1, 5, 6 and 7). Partial update: only present fields change. The current revision must be presented in the HTTP If-Match header; a missing or stale revision is refused with revision_conflict (412). Secret fields are write-only: api_key is accepted as a string (or null to clear), stored as a 0600 file referenced as SecretRef{File}, and never returned by any read. When agent.settings.accept_secrets is false, the presence of api_key is refused with secrets_not_accepted. A write that changes the model host to one not already in the calling principal's egress_ack must carry egress_confirmation naming exactly that host, and extends egress_ack for that host only (D4). A write that changes the backend scheme, host or port without api_key in the same request does not apply a key stored through this API to the new backend and clears it (ADR-0012); the response then carries key_not_carried. A key supplied by reference (environment variable or file) is unaffected. The response on success is the read shape (settings-read.schema.json) with the new revision.

system_prompt.description: Replacement for the custom part of the system prompt. The fixed safety prefix is always prepended by the server and cannot be removed, emptied or overridden by this value.

kind.description: Switch the backend kind (openai: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; uar: Universal Agent Runtime, D14).

base_url.description: New backend base URL. Never carries credentials; keys go in api_key only. A change to a host not already acknowledged needs egress_confirmation.

api_key.description: Write-only. A string replaces the stored key; null clears it. Refused with secrets_not_accepted when agent.settings.accept_secrets is false (on LKE the key is set out-of-band as a Kubernetes Secret, ADR-0009 section 5). Never appears in the read shape.

host.description: The exact newly chosen model host the caller confirms it may send node content to (D4). It must equal the host of the base_url in the same write; any other egress change is refused with egress_confirmation_required.

EgressConfirmation.description: Required exactly when the write changes the model host to one not already in the calling principal's egress_ack. Extends egress_ack for this host only.
